purpose: Localize the known 4D radial anomaly and run a new fixed independent-generator control; do not replace the original V1b gate.
known_before_run: The radial input U and reconstructed W have exactly the same pooled KS statistic and p-value. Maximum pointwise reconstruction error is 3.774758283725532e-15.
Historical seeds 0 and 4294967295 have unadjusted radial p-values 0.0272340 and 0.0034720; these subdivisions were examined retrospectively.
No significant cause is assigned from these unblinded diagnostics; new data have not been generated.
seed_policy: SHA256(namespace + /mulberry32/ + candidate), first four bytes little endian. Exclude reserved state intervals overlapping earlier selected intervals or historical intervals, without inspecting PRNG outputs; record every skipped candidate. Philox keys: SHA256(namespace + /philox32/ + index), first sixteen bytes little endian, distinct keys. Seeds and keys are fixed once, not tuned.

arms.philox32: NumPy Philox 4x64, distinct direct 128-bit keys, high 32 bits of each raw uint64 divided by 2^32, injected into the exact same core.js samplePoint(). Same finite uniform grid as native RNG.

primary_tests: For each of two arms: pooled two-sided KS of recovered W versus U(0,1), method exact.
For each of two arms: one-sided binomial upper tail for number of 32 batches whose exact radial KS p-value is below 0.05, versus nominal probability 0.05.
positive_control: First Philox batch U^3, corresponding to erroneous uniform radius rather than cube-root radius; must reject at p < 1e-6.
secondary_diagnostics: Raw-input versus reconstructed KS; pointwise identity, strict support, rejections and draw consumption.
Historical KS location x=0.43093082611449063: fresh signed CDF excess and nominal one-sided binomial p, descriptive.
Per-stream inner counts at theta=0.10,...,0.85 recorded, with no new proper-time qualification.
Nominal iid DKW upper CDF-distance radius at 97.5% for each arm; descriptive and conditional on iid, no PRNG independence guarantee.
stop_rule: Execute all 32 batches per arm once. Keep every batch and all radial raw inputs/reconstructions. No seed replacement, extra batches, sampler edits, or threshold changes after observing fresh results. Abort on source mismatch, exceeded fixed draw budget or missing raw data. Preserve failed run if any.
output_decision: NO_DISCREPANCY_DETECTED_IN_FIXED_FOLLOWUP only if all four primary screens, support/identity checks, and positive control pass; otherwise FOLLOWUP_HOLD. Neither outcome changes the historical V1b NOT_PASSED.
interpretation_limits: Finite deterministic streams are not mathematically independent continuous observations; all KS/binomial/DKW probability statements use the declared ideal iid reference model.
Distinct non-overlapping native state windows do not prove statistical independence. A different Philox key is a separate algorithmic control, not physical randomness.
No rejection is not a proof of uniformity, no bound on all seeds or dimensions, and no validation of physical spacetime or curvature.
The 32-bit grid differs from the continuous uniform CDF by at most 2^-32; no post-hoc adjustment of the old gate is permitted.
The original four-seed radial FAIL remains a recorded failure even if this fresh follow-up does not reproduce it.
